what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Russia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5488 Ukrainian refugees in Russia, 0.1% of all refugees from Ukraine.
Germany hosts the most Ukrainian refugees, followed by Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022 and over Donetsk territory in 2014.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 2297 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 1275315, at the end of 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 and 2023, and the figure was far lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Russia.
These are year-end totals for Russia only, reported to UNHCR.
